text.body: || praṇavopaniṣat 2 || brahma ha vai brahmāṇaṃ puṣkare puṣkare sasṛje | sa khalu brahmā sṛṣṭaścintāmāpede | kenāhamekenākṣareṇa sarvāṃśca kāmānsarvāṃśca lokān sarvāṃśca devān sarvāṃśca vedān sarvāṃśca yajñān sarvāṃśca śabdān sarvāṃśca vyuṣṭīḥ sarvāṇi ca bhūtāni sthāvarajaṅgamānyanubhaveyamiti | sa brahmacaryamacarat | sa omityetadakṣaramapaśyat | vivarṇaṃ caturmātraṃ sarvavyāpi sarvavibhvayātayāmabrahma brāhmīṃ vyāhṛtiṃ brahmadaivataṃ tathā sarvāṃśca kāmān sarvāṃśca lokān sarvāṃśca devān sarvāṃśca vedān sarvāṃśca yajñān sarvāṃśca śabdān sarvāṃśca vyuṣṭīḥ sarvāṇi ca bhūtāni sthāvarajaṅgamānyanvabhavat | tasya prathamena varṇenāpasnehaścānvabhavat | tasya dvitīyena varṇena tejo jyotīṃṣyanvabhavat | tasya prathamayā svaramātrayā pṛthivīmagnimoṣadhivanaspatīnṛgvedaṃ bhūriti vyāhṛtirgāyatraṃ chandastrivṛtaṃ stomaṃ prācīṃ diśaṃ vasantamṛtuṃ vācamadhyātmaṃ jihvāṃ rasamitīndriyāṇyanvabhavat | tasya dvitīyayā svaramātrayāntarikṣaṃ vāyuṃ yajurvedaṃ bhuva iti vyāhṛtiṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ pañcadaśaṃ stomaṃ pratīcīṃ diśaṃ grīṣmamṛtuṃ prāṇamadhyātmaṃ nāsike gandhaghrāṇamitīndriyāṇyanvabhavat | tasya tṛtīyayā svaramātrayā divamādityaṃ sāmavedaṃ svaritivyāhṛtiṃ jāgataṃ chandaḥ saptadaśaṃ stomabhudīcīṃ diśaṃ varṣartuṃ jyotiradhyātmaṃ cakṣuṣī darśanamitīndriyaṇayanvabhavat | tasya vakāramātrayā yaścandramasamatharvavedaṃ nakṣatrāṇyomiti svamātmānaṃ janadityaṅgirasāmānuṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ ekaviṃśaṃ stomaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ śaradamṛtuṃ mano'dhyātmaṃ jñānaṃ jñeyamitīndriyāṇyanvabhavat | tasya makāraśrutyetihāsapurāṇaṃ vākovākyagāthānārāśaṃsīrupaniṣadonuśāsamānānāmiti vṛdhatkaradruhanmahattacchamomiti vyāhṛtīḥ svaraśamyanānātantrīsvaranṛtyagītavāditrāṇyanvabhavaccaitrarathaṃ daivataṃ vaidyutaṃ jyotirbārhataṃ chandastṛṇavattrayastriṃśastomau dhruvāmūrdhvāṃ diśaṃ hemantaśiśirāvṛtū śrotramadhyātmaṃ śabdaśravaṇamitīndriyāṇyanvabhavat | saiṣaikākṣara ṛgbrahmaṇastapaso'gre prādurbabhūva | brahma vedasyātharvaṇaṃ śukramata eva mantrāḥ prādurbabhūvuḥ | sa tu khalu mantrāṇāṃ tapasā śuśrūṣānadhyāyādhyanena yadūnaṃ ca variṣṭhaṃ ca yātayāmaṃ ca karoti | tathāpyatharvaṇaṃ tejasā pratyāpyāyayenmantrāśca māmabhimukhībhaveyurgarbhā iva mātaramabhijighāṃsuḥ parastādoṅkāraprayuktayaitayaiva tadṛcā pratyāpyāyayedeṣa yajñasya purastādyujyata eṣā paścāt sarvata etayā yajñastapate tadapyetadṛcoktaṃ `yā purastādyuñjata ṛco'kṣare parame vyomanniti' | tadetadakṣaraṃ brāhmaṇo yaṃ kāmamicchet trirātropoṣitaḥ prāṅmukho vāgyato barhipyupaviśya sahasraṃ ṛca āvartayet sidhyantyasyārthāḥ sarvakarmāṇi ceti brāhmaṇam || vasordvārāṇāmindranagaraṃ tadasurāḥ paryavārayanta | te devā bhītā āsan | ka imānasurān haniṣyatīti | tamoṅkāraṃ brahmaṇaḥ putraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ dadṛśuste tamabruvan | bhavatā mukhyenemānasurān jayemeti | sa hovāca kiṃ me pratīvāho bhaviṣyatīti | varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti | vṛṇa iti | sa varamavṛṇīta | ``na māmanīrayitvā brāhmaṇā brahma vadeyuryadi vadeyurabrahma tatsyāt iti | tatheti te devā devayajanasyottarārdhe'raiḥ saṃyattā āsaṃstānoṅkāreṇāgnīdhrīyā devā asurān parābhāvayanta | tadyatparābhāvayanta tasmādoṅkāraḥ pūrvamuccāryate | yo ha vā etamoṅkāraṃ na vedāvaśyaḥsyādityatha ya evaṃ veda brahmavaśaḥ syāditi tasmādoṅkāra ṛgbhavati yajuṣi yajuḥ sāmni sāma sūtre sūtraṃ brāhmaṇe brāhmaṇaṃ śloke ślokaḥ praṇave praṇava iti brāhmaṇam || oṅkāraṃ pṛcchāmaḥ ko dhātuḥ kiṃ prātipadikaṃ kiṃ nāmākhyātaṃ kiṃ liṅgaṃ kiṃ ca vacanaṃ kā vibhaktiḥ kaḥ pratyayaḥ kaḥ svaraḥ upasargo nipātaḥ kiṃ vai vyākaraṇaṃ ko vikāraḥ ko vikārī katimātraḥ kativarṇaḥ katyakṣaraḥ katipadaḥ kaḥ saṃyogaḥ kiṃ sthānānupradānakaraṇaṃ śikṣakāḥ kimuccārayanti kiṃ chandaḥ ko varṇa iti pūrve praśnāḥ | athottare mantrāḥ | kalpo brāhmaṇaṃ ṛg yajuḥ sāma | kasmādbrahmavādina oṅkāramāditaḥ kurvanti | kiṃ daivataṃ kiṃ jyotiṣaṃ kiṃ niruktaṃ kiṃ sthānaṃ kā prakṛtiḥ kimadhyātmamiti ṣaṭtriṃśatpraśnāḥ pūrvottarāṇāṃ trayo vargā dvādaśa ekāśatairoṅkāraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || indraḥ prajāpatimapṛcchat bhagavannabhyastūya pṛcchāmīti | pṛccha vatsetyabravīt | kimayamoṅkāraḥ kasya putraḥ kiṃ caitacchandaḥ kiṃ caitadvarṇaḥ kiṃ caitadbrahmā brahma sampadyate | tasmādvaitamoṅkāraṃ pūrvamālobhasvaritodātta ekākṣara oṅkāra ṛgvede traisvaryodātta ekākṣara oṅkāro yajurvede dīrghaplutodātta ekākṣara oṅkāraḥ sāmavede hrasvodātta ekākṣaraḥ ukāro'tharvavede'nudāttodāttadvipada a u ityardhacatasro mātrā makāre vyañjanamityāhuḥ | yā sā prathamā mātrā brahmadaivatyā raktā varṇena yastāṃ dhyāyate nityaṃ sa gacchedbrāhmaṃ padam | yā sā dvitīyā mātrā viṣṇudaivatyā kṛṣṇā varṇena yastāṃ dhyāyate nityaṃ sa gacchedvaiṣṇavaṃ padam | yā sā tṛtīyā mātrā īśānadaivatyā kapilā varṇena yastāṃ dhyāyate nityaṃ sa gacchedaiśānaṃ padam | yā sārdhacaturthī mātrā sarvadaivatyā vyaktībhūtā khaṃ vicarati śuddhasphaṭikasannibhā varṇena yastāṃ dhyāyate nityaṃ sa gacchet padamanāmakam | oṅkārasyotpattiṃ vipro yo na jānāti tatpunarupanayanaṃ tasmādbrāhmaṇavacanamādartavyam | yathā lātavyo gotro brāhmaṇaḥ | putro gāyatraṃ chandaḥ śuklo varṇaḥ | puṃso vatso rudro devatā | oṅkāro vedānāṃ uttaropaniṣadaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | ko dhāturityāpterdhāturavatimapyeke | rūpasāmānyādyarthasāmānyānyanyadīyastasmādāperoṅkāraḥ sarvamāpnotītyarthaḥ | kṛdantamarthavatprātipadikamadarśanaṃ pratyayasya nāma sampadyate | nipāteṣu cainaṃ vaiyyākaraṇā ukṣattaṃ samāmananti | tadavyayībhūtamanvarthavācī śabdo na vyeti kadācaneti | sadṛśaṃ triṣu liṅgeṣu sarvāsu ca vibhaktiṣu | vacaneṣu ca sarveṣu yanna vyeti tadavyayam || ko vikārī cyavate prakāraṇamāpnotirākārapakārau vikāryau āditaḥ okāro vikriyate | dvitīyo makāra evaṃ dvivarṇa ekākṣara omityoṅkāro nirvṛttaḥ | katimātra ityādestisro mātrāḥ abhyādhāne hi plavate | makāraścaturthī kiṃ sthānamityubhāvoṣṭhau sthānamādhānakaraṇī ca dviḥsthānaṃ sandhyakṣaramavarṇaleśaḥ kaṇṭhyo yathoktaśeṣaḥ pūrvo vivṛttakaraṇasthitaśca dvitīyaḥ spṛṣṭakaraṇasthitaśca | nāyaṃ yoge vidyuta ākhyātopasargānudāttaḥ svaritaliṅgavibhaktivacanāni ca sañcchinnādhyāyina ācāryāḥ pūrve babhūbuḥ | śravaṇādevaṃ pratipadyante | na kāraṇaṃ prayacchantyathāparapakṣīyāṇāṃ kaviḥ pañcālacaṇḍaḥ paripṛcchako babhūvāṃbuḥ pṛthagudgīthadoṣān bhavanto bruvantviti | tadvācyupalakṣayet varṇākṣarapadāṅkaśo vibhaktyāmṛṣiniṣevitāmiti vācaṃ stuvanti | tasmāt kāraṇaṃ brūmo varṇānāmayamidaṃ bhaviṣyatīti ṣaḍaṅgavidastattayādhīmahi | kiṃ chanda iti | gāyatraṃ hi chando gāyatrī devānāmekākṣarā śvetavarṇā ca vyākhyātā | dvau dvādaśakau vargāvetadvai vyākaraṇaṃ dhātvarthavacanaṃ śaikṣaṃ chando vacanaṃ cāthottarau dvau dvādaśakau vargau vedarahasikī vyākhyātā mantrakalpo brāhmaṇamṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇyeṣā vyāhṛtiścaturṇāṃ vedānāmānupūrvyeṇa | oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvariti vyāhṛtayaḥ || asamīkṣya pravalhitāni śrūyante dvāparādāvṛṣīṇāmekadeśo doṣayatīha cintāmāpede | tribhiḥ somaḥ pātavyaḥ samāptamiva bhavati | tasmādṛgyajussāmānyapakrāntatejāṃsyāsaṃstatra maharṣayaḥ paridevayāñcakrira | mahacchokabhayaṃ prāptāḥ smo na caitasarvaiḥ samabhihitaṃ te vayaṃ bhagavantamevopadhāvāma | sarveṣāmeva śarma bhavāniti | te tathetyuktvā tūṣṇīmatiṣṭhannānupasannebhya ityupopasīdāmeti nīcairbabhūbuḥ | sa ebhya upanīya provāca | māmikāmeva vyāhṛtimāditaḥ kṛṇudhvamityevaṃ māmakā adhīyante | nartte bhṛgvaṅgirovidbhyaḥ somaḥ pātavya ṛtvijaḥ parābhavanti | yajamāno rajasāpadhvasyati śrutiścāpadhvastāpatiṣṭhatītyevamevottarottarādyogāllokaṃ tokaṃ praśādhvamityevaṃ pratāpo na parābhaviṣyatīti | tathāha bhagavanniti pratipedire āpyāyayaṃste tathā vītaśokabhayā babhūvuḥ | tasmādbrahmavādina oṅkāramāditaḥ kurvanti || kiṃ daivatamityṛcāmagnirdaivataṃ tadeva jyotirgāyatraṃ chandaḥ pṛthivī sthānaṃ ``agnimīḍe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam | hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam | ityevamādiṃ kṛtvā ṛgvedamadhīyate | yajuṣāṃ vāyurdaivataṃ tadeva jyotistraiṣṭubhaṃ chando'ntarikṣaṃ sthānaṃ ``iṣe tvorje tvā vāyavaḥ sthopāyavaḥ stha devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇe ityevamādiṃ kṛtvā yajurvedamadhīyate | sāmnādityo daivataṃ tadeva jyotirjāgataṃ chando dyauḥ sthānaṃ ``agna āyāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye | nihotā satsi barhiṣi | ityevamādiṃ kṛtvā sāmavedamadhīyate | atharvaṇāṃ candramā daivataṃ tadeva jyotiḥ sarvāṇi chandāṃsyāpaḥ sthānaṃ ``śanno devīrabhiṣṭaye ityevamādiṃ kṛtvā atharvavedamadhīyate | adbhyaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamo bhūtagrāmaḥ sambhavati | tasmāt sarvamāpomayaṃ bhūtaṃ sarvaṃ bhṛgvaṅgiromayaṃ antaraite trayo vedā bhṛgūnaṅgirasaḥ śritā ityabiti prakṛtirapāmoṅkāreṇa caitasmādvyāsaḥ ||
